title: Uma Carats
description: Adds the currency from Umamusume! (It's edible too)
body:
## Uma Carats
Why eat Golden Carrots when Uma Carats?!

Uma Carats are made from one golden carrot surronded by 8 diamonds, it crafts 8 at a time, so one for each of your diamonds!

When eaten it gives 4 hunger bars, 15.5 saturation (golden carrot is 14.4), regeneration 2, speed 6, jump boost 3, and absorption 2 so you can feel like a true uma!

And since each one requires at least 1 diamond to make, you can even use it as a currency if you wanted!
